exercises.question: Which sentence says: Although every citizen has the right to vote, many do not go?
options: Annak ellenére, hogy minden állampolgárnak joga van a szavazásra, sokan nem mennek el.
Annak ellenére, hogy minden állampolgárnak joga van a szavazásra, ezért sokan nem mennek el.
Annak ellenére, mert minden állampolgárnak joga van a szavazásra, sokan nem mennek el.

exercises.english: The voting is in the school.

exercises.sentence: Annak ellenére, ____ minden állampolgárnak joga van a szavazáshoz, sokan nem élnek vele.
exercises.english: Despite the fact that every citizen has the right to vote, many do not exercise it.

exercises.question: What does jogállamiság mean?
options: the state itself also follows the laws
laws apply to citizens but not to the authorities
citizens may decide which laws to obey

exercises.english: The meeting of the local government was on Friday.

exercises.question: What does állampolgári kötelesség mean?
options: something citizens have to do for the community
a benefit that only members of parliament get
money that the state pays to every citizen
